luot1.prompt: Cinematic close-up of a champagne glass tower: four tiers of identical plain, unmarked coupe glasses stacked in a pyramid on a dark wooden table in a dim room with warm, low light. A thin, steady stream of pale golden sparkling wine falls from above the top edge of the frame into the single glass at the very top; no bottle, no hand and no person is visible. The top glass fills and gently overflows, and the wine runs down evenly over its rim into the glasses of the tier below, which slowly begin to fill. Fine bubbles rise in the glasses. Very slow push-in, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh background, realistic liquid physics, smooth natural motion. No people, no hands, no faces, no labels, no logos, no text anywhere in the frame.
luot1.negative: people, hands, faces, bottle label, logo, text, letters, watermark, broken glass, shattering, splashing explosion, wine spraying, foam overflowing everywhere, glasses melting or morphing, extra floating glasses

luot1.prompt: Quiet apartment interior in soft, overcast late-afternoon light, locked-off camera. A tall window with sheer white curtains fills the right half of the frame; beyond the glass a city is only a soft blur. In the out-of-focus middle distance a single adult figure stands by the window, seen only from behind: back of the head, shoulders and dark sweater, small in the frame and never sharp. The figure holds a phone at chest height; its screen is a faint, featureless glow, not visible to the camera. After about four seconds, the figure, keeping their back to the camera the whole time, steps to the right and walks out of the frame. The final two seconds show only the empty window, the curtains moving very slightly, and no one in the room. Muted natural colors, shallow depth of field, realistic, cinematic. No face ever visible, no readable screen, no text, no logos.
luot1.negative: face, facial features, profile view, turning around, looking at the camera, second person, crowd, readable phone screen, text, letters, logo, watermark, rain falling, person fading or dissolving, person reappearing
